verdict.rationale: For a coding assistant, the user's data is their codebase. Aider documents `/ask` for questions about the code without edits, `AI?` comments in watch mode that trigger answers, and a repo map that grounds its answers in the whole repository. Community users report it doing a fantastic job of explaining unfamiliar codebases and answering questions that LSP search can't. missing for 10: proactive or unprompted insights (all insights are user-initiated in chat), insights over data other than code/repo and shared command output, and in-depth docs describing the quality or scope of ask-mode analysis.
